submittedParameters.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. ONE EAST-running ice-sword girl game sprite, true alpha, native at least1024 square.
Edit target image 1 is the approved character identity and scale reference for this trial. Image 2 original identity. Image 3 MAIN hand-painted style only. Keep same face, same head and bun size and precise placement, same chest/waist proportions, hair, camera and scale. Keep right near arm holding the one ice sword, left far arm holding blue talisman. Do not swap props, mirror, duplicate or redesign.
Draw a different frame E03: middle of RIGHT-foot stance after weight acceptance. The near RIGHT boot is firmly flat, its center now directly below pelvis around x=65%, outsole y=95.5% of canvas. Bend its knee forward slightly so the thigh and calf carry weight; show a strong compressed knee/ankle and pelvis over that planted foot. The far LEFT leg swings forward: LEFT thigh advances toward screen-right, knee bent and low, raised foot passes behind support calf with toe clear of ground by 8% canvas; separate leg contours. The right sword arm now passes closer beside hip, right elbow bent, sword remains trailing left and down, entire blade clear; left talisman hand gently recedes with opposite arm swing. Keep torso lean small and natural, not a high kick. Make a visible stance, not jumping. Clothes and hair follow with subtle lag.
Fixed canvas: do not magnify or recenter. Keep bun top y=7%, face eye center approximately[77%,41%], head width and height exactly image1, shoulder near[61%,52%]. Root remains [50%,95.5%]; full transparent square with space around blade, no floor/shadow/debug lines/text. Anatomical movement only, no whole-image up/down shift. Native independently painted single frame, not sheet. Target maximum fine hand-painted finish, preserve bright rounded chibi style and single straight ice sword.
